wish: someone should make a tool that draws convolutional neural network diagrams
spec:
Draws a LeNet-style block diagram of a convolutional network: 3D blocks for conv/pool feature maps, bars for dense layers, kernel marks and arrows.
Type one layer per line (conv 28x28x6 5x5, pool 14x14x6, fc 120) or start from a LeNet, AlexNet or VGG preset; download as SVG or PNG, or copy the SVG.
It does not read model files from PyTorch or Keras, and does not draw branching architectures like ResNet skips or Inception.
notes: Diagram layout is a single left-to-right chain; scale is logarithmic so AlexNet-sized nets fit on a phone.
